verdict.rationale: Docs mention a vague 'discover new sources' feature but give no evidence of scholarly-database or primary-source search (e.g., Google Scholar, PubMed, JSTOR integration); a hands-on community report explicitly states 'you couldn't just have it search for docs and then incorporate them into your research' — you had to supply URLs/files yourself, directly contradicting the search claim. Missing for 10: evidence of actual scholarly/primary-source search integration, citation/database coverage details, and confirmation that discovery works as advertised.
